import sales from './sales.json' with {type:'json'};

const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

function isValidISODate(s) {
  if (typeof s !== 'string' || !ISO_DATE.test(s)) return false;
  const [y, m, d] = s.split('-').map(Number);
  // Check that date is real
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
  return date.getUTCFullYear() === y && date.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 && date.getUTCDate() === d;
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'sales_report',
    description: 'Sum sales rows within an inclusive date range',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        start_date: {type: 'string', description: 'Start date (inclusive) in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD'},
        end_date: {type: 'string', description: 'End date (inclusive) in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD'}
      },
      required: ['start_date', 'end_date'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'sales_report') {
    throw new Error('Unknown tool');
  }
  // Check for extra fields
  const allowedKeys = new Set(['start_date', 'end_date']);
  for (const k of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowedKeys.has(k)) {
      throw new Error(`Unexpected field: ${k}`);
    }
  }
  // Validate args
  if (!args || typeof args !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments');
  }
  const {start_date, end_date} = args;
  if (!start_date || !end_date) {
    throw new Error('Missing required fields');
  }
  if (!isValidISODate(start_date) || !isValidISODate(end_date)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid ISO date format');
  }
  if (start_date > end_date) {
    throw new Error('start_date must not be after end_date');
  }
  // Sum
  let total = 0;
  let count = 0;
  for (const row of sales) {
    if (row.date >= start_date && row.date <= end_date) {
      total += row.amount;
      count++;
    }
  }
  return {
    content: [{type: 'text', text: `Total: ${total} from ${count} row(s)`}]
  };
}
